# 获取帮助 / Get help

| 需求 / Need | 入口 / Route |
|---|---|
| 安装、选型、使用疑问 / Installation and usage questions | [Discussions](https://github.com/fishzjp/qa-skills/discussions) |
| 可复现缺陷 / Reproducible defect | [Bug report](https://github.com/fishzjp/qa-skills/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) |
| 具体能力建议 / Feature request | [Feature request](https://github.com/fishzjp/qa-skills/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) |
| 安全问题 / Security issue | [Private reporting](./SECURITY.md) |
| 行为投诉 / Conduct complaint | [Code of Conduct](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) |

先阅读 [中文 README](../README.md) / [English README](../README.en.md) 和 [入门练习](../examples/first-task/README.md)。报告问题时提供安装方式、tag/commit、Agent 与模型版本、操作系统、实际装载路径和脱敏复现材料。不要上传密钥、生产账号或私有业务数据。

Read the README and [first-task walkthrough](../examples/first-task/README.en.md) first. Include the installation method, tag/commit, agent/model versions, OS, actual loaded paths and a redacted reproduction. Do not upload secrets, production accounts or private business data.

本项目由个人维护，按复现清晰度与影响处理，不提供保证的响应时间或生产支持 SLA。确认的安装失败、错误覆盖、错误输出等问题优先于新增能力。未回复不代表已接受或已拒绝；有新增证据时更新原帖即可。

This project is individually maintained and prioritizes reproducibility and impact. There is no guaranteed response time or production-support SLA. Confirmed installation failures, incorrect overwrites and incorrect outputs take priority over feature expansion. Silence is neither acceptance nor rejection; add new evidence to the existing thread.
